content: # Java in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} Support for Java in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} is provided through a wide range of [extensions](/docs/java/extensions.md). Combined with the power of core {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}, these extensions give you a lightweight and performant code editor that also supports many of the most common Java development techniques. This article will give you an overview of different capabilities of {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} for Java developers.
